about: Pre-registered story-pocket targets per locality scenario: roles, occurrence bands, size targets and story frequencies. Read by tools/showcase-scoreboard.mjs. Generated, not hand-typed: change a rule or an override in tools/story-pocket-targets.mjs and rewrite.

rules.status: PROPOSED by Claude 2026-10-22; awaiting the boss. The rules are design choices; the evidence each target rests on is cited per entry.
rules.wanted_share_basis: A species is wanted from a locality when it holds at least 5 % of the locality's record (Mineralienatlas photographs and eBay listings, compare.json "real"), as the scoreboard has used since 2026-10-21. Where the record is too thin to vote, the collectibles the sources name (named_signatures).
rules.occurrence: A run in which at least one crystal of the species survives (census n_surv > 0), at any size.
rules.occurrence_bands_basis: The literature's abundance class for the deposit (proposals/DATA-LOCALITY-ABUNDANCE-2026-10-21.json, literature), read as the share of story pockets the species occurs in: abundant at least half, common at least 30 %, uncommon 10–60 %, rare 2–30 %, very rare at most 15 %. The numbers are a design choice, not measured. A form suffix (-crust, -coating, -oxidized) keeps the class. doc (documented without an abundance word), ND, ND?, Q and no class leave the band unresolved. Photograph and listing shares are never used: they measure collector salience, not geological frequency.
rules.size_basis: Photographed lengths (proposals/DATA-STORY-POCKET-SIZES-CAPTURE-2026-10-22.json, classed by tools/story-pocket-size-evidence.mjs), one value per photograph: its largest stated crystal of the species. With at least size_min_samples photographs, a crystal target: confidence low below size_medium_confidence, medium below size_high_confidence, high from it. Otherwise the photographs' specimen dimensions, if at least size_min_samples, as a proxy: an upper bound on the crystal, confidence low. Otherwise unknown. There is no default size. Materials collected as pieces (tiger's eye, chrysoprase, chalcedony, jasper) have piece sizes only, so at best a proxy.
rules.size_check: Per run, the species' largest crystal not flagged as enclosed (census max_exp_mm) against the target: the median is the characteristic crystal and the lower quartile (q25) the showcase threshold. Over the runs where the species occurs in a cavity that fits its median, MEETS when at least half reach q25, OVERSIZE when their median passes q90, BELOW otherwise. A proxy is an upper bound, so reaching it is conclusive and falling short is not (BELOW PROXY).
rules.eligibility: A cavity fits a species' characteristic crystal when its longest interior span (the longest chord between two wall vertices, tools/story-pocket-cavities.mjs) is at least the target's median. A pocket is SMALL when it cannot fit the primary protagonist's characteristic crystal: it may lack a showcase and is left out of the story frequency. The locality's target is never shrunk to fit the cavity. Under a proxy, a cavity smaller than the proxy median is unclassed, not small.
rules.story_frequency_rule: A run carries the story when an intended protagonist (the primary or an alternate) occurs and its largest unflagged crystal reaches its target's q25. The scenario should carry it in at least the largest lower occurrence bound among its protagonists that have an engine and a band: the most common protagonist should usually tell the story. Unresolved when no such protagonist exists.
rules.roles: From the record, gated by the literature (deriveRoles, tools/story-pocket-lib.mjs): primary = the most-wanted species the literature does not contradict (ND, ND?, Q) or call rare (RA, VR); alternate = every other such wanted species; showpiece = a wanted species the literature calls rare; unsupported = a wanted species the literature contradicts (listed, not targeted); companion = a species the literature calls abundant or common that the record does not want (the supporting cast: it should occur, not be the star). Species the comparison sets aside as outside the scenario's scope have no role.
rules.companions_and_showpieces: Companions are scored on occurrence against their band and on not being the star; showpieces on occurrence against their band and, where a size target exists, on how often they reach it. Neither carries the story.
